pipeline.target: HBV cccDNA elimination via ARCUS nuclease

indications.trial_design: First-in-human dose-finding, repeat-administration LNP-delivered gene-editing trial; cohorts evaluating 0.2/0.4/0.8 mg/kg every 8 weeks and 0.4/0.65 mg/kg every 4 weeks
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING; late-breaking Phase 1 data presented at AASLD Nov 2025; additional clinical/biopsy data expected first half of 2026; Part 2 expansion to follow
key_milestones: AASLD late-breaker Nov 10, 2025: safety + dose-dependent antiviral activity

pipeline.modality: In vivo AAV-delivered dual ARCUS nuclease gene editing (excises exons 45-55 of dystrophin gene)

indications.indication: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (mutations amenable to exon 45-55 excision)
indications.trial_design: Open-label safety and preliminary efficacy of single IV PBGENE-DMD in ambulatory DMD patients at specialized US sites
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING (start 2026-04-24); IND cleared Feb 2026; initial data from multiple patients expected by year-end 2026

excluded_preclinical: PBGENE-3243 (mitochondrial m.3243G disease) - development paused to prioritize HBV and DMD programs
excluded_legacy_terminated: PBCAR20A (allogeneic anti-CD20 CAR T) - Phase 1/2 COMPLETED 2021-06-24, no further development
PBCAR269A (BCMA CAR T, MM) - Phase 1 TERMINATED 2022-10-19
excluded_partner_owned: ECUR-506 (neonatal onset OTC deficiency, OTC-HOPE study) - sponsored and conducted by partner iECURE; ARCUS nuclease licensed but program is partner-owned
Azer-cel (DLBCL) - now developed by Imugene under license, partner-owned
ARCUS in vivo collaborations with Eli Lilly and Novartis - partner-controlled (e.g., Novartis sickle cell / beta thalassemia)
